data.content_ref: inline:The 'abstracts' relation is semantically inverted. SRC_002 states that the isolated artifact 0e26d6be54fd 'abstracts the harness specification,' then defines this as the artifact being 'a concrete instance of a general pattern the harness spec describes.' That is instantiation, not abstraction: the harness spec (the general pattern) abstracts over the concrete artifact; the concrete token cannot 'abstract' the more general type it is an instance of. A relation whose kind label names the wrong direction of the abstraction arrow does not correctly connect the isolated artifact to its neighbourhood as the problem requires — it misclassifies the dependence direction between token and type.
